notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Connect the finance task to the right sales motion.
intro: A proposed revenue-orchestration workbench for Endex: match finance buyers to concrete document and analysis workflows, then resolve channel ownership before a handoff.
queueIntro: All finance teams and workflow scenarios are fictional. The demo contains no investment recommendations, transaction advice or confidential models.
workbenchIntro: Review workflow relevance, evidence and channel ownership. A product-usage event or public signal does not by itself establish a qualified deal.
firstBuild: A finance-workflow brief with one next owner
firstBody: Connect the team’s recurring Excel, document or presentation task to a grounded why-now hypothesis, qualification criteria and an unambiguous seller handoff.

fields.label: Finance team and use case distinguished
Document or analysis workflow question recorded
Source and timing of buying signal recorded
Inbound, outbound and partner ownership reconciled
Receiving seller and next task assigned

rules.title: Identify the actual finance workflow
rules.next: Separate a private-equity research task, investment-banking presentation and corporate-finance model instead of using one generic finance pitch.

rules.title: Name the work to be improved
rules.next: Ground the brief in an Excel, document or presentation task without requesting confidential files.

rules.title: Attach the why-now evidence
rules.next: Keep a public signal distinct from confirmed evaluation interest. Record what still needs discovery.

rules.title: Resolve the channel collision
rules.next: Preserve a partner introduction or existing opportunity instead of assigning a second seller.

rules.title: Define the qualification step
rules.next: Document business context, sponsor and next action before advancing a lead based on activity alone.

rules.title: Give the brief an accountable owner
rules.next: A useful account brief needs a receiving seller and a concrete follow-up task.

ready.title: Ready for finance-workflow discovery review
ready.next: The seller can review the task hypothesis, signal evidence and agreed next step. Any product fit or evaluation scope still requires discovery.

experiments.name: Task-specific finance discovery
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete work product helps the buyer assess relevance.
experiments.treatment: Team-specific model, memo or presentation question
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: One owner across channels
experiments.hypothesis: Resolving partner and inbound overlap reduces lead rework.
experiments.treatment: Unified account key and relationship-aware routing
experiments.primary: Accepted handoffs within the agreed service window
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Define the finance buyer and pipeline states
roadmap.body: Work with the CEO and GTM team on use-case segments, qualification and channel ownership.

roadmap.title: Build one workflow-to-pipeline motion
roadmap.body: Join research and product context to a reviewed brief. Instrument failed joins and routing conflicts.
roadmap.measure: Useful briefs and correct handoff ownership

roadmap.title: Improve the full conversion path
roadmap.body: Compare vertical and channel cohorts through held discovery and qualified opportunities. Expand only after learning from losses.
roadmap.measure: Stage conversion and qualified pipeline by source
